My dear [Mrs Keble](/person/797)
How very stupid and ungrateful you must have thought me, but I never saw [your Son](/person/799)’s letter when I opened – and answered yours, and only found it this morning.

It satisfies me all the more as being what I was always inclined to think.

yours affectionately

C M Yonge


[^1]: Elizabeth Jane Clarke (1804–1870) married (1835) the Reverend Thomas Keble, younger brother of John Keble who married her younger sister Charlotte in 1835.
[^2]: Probably after John Keble\'s death in 1866 and before Elizabeth Keble\'s death in September 1870.

Placed here on the assumption that it relates to the composition of [Musings over the \'Christian Year\'](/book/88) (1871).
